name: ULTIMATE RACING
changes: Fixed the player drift chassis rotation: apply the calculated drift yaw to the visible 3D car body, align camera and collision envelope to that body heading, and smooth drift entry/recovery.

Separated guardrail proximity from impact: approaching or running alongside the rail does not brake the car; crossing the road edge while moving outward creates an impact-scaled speed loss, cooldown and inward yaw response.

Removed artificial per-frame tyre-scrub speed subtraction from ordinary cornering; lateral traction utilization now reduces available drive force smoothly only near the grip threshold, without a corner-specific fixed speed cap.
Improved Easy AI behaviour: rivals detect a closing player in the same corridor and yield toward available lateral space; collision laws remain shared across all difficulties.

Added selectable and persistent Normal/Ghost AI vehicle mode for Grand Prix. Ghost mode makes AI vehicles translucent and disables racer-to-racer collisions only; road-edge constraints and route progress continue.
Recalibrated drift steering between the former twitchy and overly heavy configurations using 1.50 yaw authority, 0.31s drift response and 0.22 lateral slip.
Reworked speed HUD formatting from the measured current m/s value; invalid or stopped values display 000 km/h and are not confused with a vehicle top-speed stat.
Added finish-position GP payouts for every finisher, +50-coin top-ten bonus, completion/win/round bonuses and idempotent run settlement; DNFs receive no completion payout.
Preserved existing car/economy data and added regression coverage for Ghost Mode persistence/visual restoration, road-edge contact, AI yielding, speed HUD and drift response.
features: Player chassis now visibly rotates 0.34–0.43 radians into a drift, with smoothed 0.14s entry and 0.22s recovery; Canvas fallback uses the same stronger body-turn feedback.
20 vehicles: 10 original free models and 10 purchasable models priced at 200–2,000 coins
Unified player/AI collision impulse response and swept two-axis collision detection
Fixed 120 Hz simulation timestep with bounded catch-up steps
Continuous corner traction and tyre scrub without a hard 277 km/h corner speed cap
No speed penalty from guardrail proximity; physical edge contact remains active
Heavier drift steering and increased drift charge rate
Actual Grand Prix finish classification and persistent career standings
Unlimited daily AI Grand Prix entries and winner settlements with duplicate-run protection
Time Attack minimum reward of 80 coins with a 30% +40 coin bonus chance
Time Attack BONUS REWARD feedback with animated result panel and coin pickup sound
Grand Prix AI Vehicle Mode: persistent Normal and translucent Ghost modes; Ghost disables racer-to-racer collision only
Easy AI player-yielding behaviour to create passing space without changing collision physics
Position-based Grand Prix coin rewards for all finishers plus top-ten, completion and win bonuses
Impact-severity-scaled guardrail collision response with no proximity braking
Current-speed HUD safely shows 000 km/h when stopped or invalid
